title: Hub-First Evidence-Closure and Company-Mapping Protocol
objective: Increase opportunity frequency by improving post-hub company mapping and evidence closure, without expanding discovery from specialist/sector screens and without weakening underwriting.
discoveryEntryUnchanged: Bloomberg/Reuters/Wind/iFinD/Yicai/FT-style generalist professional hubs remain the discovery entry. This protocol begins only after a hub event has been frozen.

mappingLoop.step1: Translate the hub event into explicit economic incidence: who receives more volume, price, utilization, bargaining power, lower input cost, lower financing cost, or lower risk?
mappingLoop.step2: Enumerate first-, second-, and third-order listed-expression archetypes bounded by max three causal jumps.
mappingLoop.step3: For each archetype, search A-share companies by business exposure and contemporaneous filings/IR, not by later winner identity.
mappingLoop.step4: Require a direct exposure sentence plus at least one contemporaneous conversion datapoint: order/backlog, segment revenue, utilization, margin, cash flow, unit economics, or quantified sensitivity.
mappingLoop.step5: Search one control company with superficially similar exposure to test expression purity.
mappingLoop.step6: If no company closes the evidence chain, record the exact missing link instead of ending with a generic No selection.

searchDirectionsAfterHub: direct beneficiary and direct harmed party
guardrails: No independent specialist-feed scanning before hub trigger.
No lowering of V1.9 underwriting gates.
Do not use later winners to backfill companies.
A single-project event remains eligible for Research if economics are sufficiently quantified; quality affects ranking, not automatic eligibility.
Non-executable stocks never count as opportunity weeks.

validationPlan.firstTest: Apply unchanged to a clean historical window not used to derive the taxonomy.
validationPlan.forwardTest: Apply to subsequent 2026 weekly forward checkpoints.
validationPlan.acceptance: Higher mapping/evidence-closure rate and more independent opportunity weeks without material degradation in 60d excess quality.
